A few handbook rules that matter for you as a new TA: teaching and governance duties (lectures, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings) come before meetings with students, and a professor does not drop one for a 1:1. Staff meetings with TAs go into free time, and CSE455 office hours are open to students. Working hours are Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and a meeting is only booked once every participant has it on their calendar. If you'd like, tell me the time you're considering for the staff meeting and I'll tell you whether it collides with anything official.

Thanks — that's very helpful. The staff meeting candidates that survive my own calendar and John's are: Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30. Could you check those three against anything official? I'll book once Mara and Prof. Alvarez confirm and you tell me which are clear.

I checked all three against the official schedule — none of them collides with an official event:

- **Tue 15:00–15:30** — clear. (CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00; CSE455 office hours start at 15:30.)
- **Wed 10:00–10:30** — clear. (CSE452 lecture and Thesis committee end at 10:00; CSE455 office hours start at 10:30.)
- **Wed 13:00–13:30** — clear. (CSE455 quiz section and Guest lecture prep both start at 13:30.)

Two things I can't judge for you: I only keep the official schedule, so people's own private appointments aren't mine to check — and I don't share anyone's calendar with a third party. Also, the booking is only complete when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change should be logged.

So from the official side you can pick any of the three; go ahead and confirm with Mara and Prof. Alvarez. Note that as a staff meeting with TAs it belongs in free time, and Prof. Alvarez's teaching and governance duties come first — if one of these collides with something of hers that isn't official, that takes priority.

Thanks both — that gives me a clear picture.

On my side, Tue 15:00 and Wed 10:00 don't work (I'm tied up with a section commitment at both), and Wed 13:00 sits right up against a lab I help cover, so those three are awkward for me next week.

Before we book anything, could we settle one thing first: do we want 30 minutes, or should we block 45–60 given this material plus grading calibration? That changes which slots are even viable.

Would the following week be easier? My week after is much clearer — Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00 or Wed 13:00 all work for me then, whichever suits you and Sarah and John. Happy to go with the group's preference. — Mara
Thanks — I'll confirm with Mara and Prof. Alvarez, then log the booking.
Noted John and Sarah. Waiting on Mara; once she confirms I'll book one of Tue 15:00-15:30 / Wed 10:00-10:30 / Wed 13:00-13:30 and put it on my calendar.

Looks like no slot works for all four of us next week: the only overlap between my free time, Sarah's and yours was Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00, and all three are awkward for Mara. So I'd back Mara's suggestion and aim for the week after.

On length: 30 minutes is what Prof. Alvarez proposed; if we go to 45-60 that's a bigger block and we'd need to find it in free time, so Prof. — your call. My schedule for the following week isn't set yet; Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00 or Wed 13:00 should be fine on my side and I'll confirm as soon as that week is fixed.

Good question on length. For me the answer is forced: my week is packed in fixed blocks, so the only windows I have around these slots are 30 minutes wide — Tue 15:00-15:30 (CSE455 office hours start at 15:30) and Wed 13:00-13:30 (quiz section starts at 13:30). A 45-60 minute block would collide on my side, in either week.

So if we want more than 30 minutes, someone else will have to own a longer window; if 30 works, then both weeks are fine for me on Tue 15:00 or Wed 13:00. Note the department office already cleared those two against the official schedule for next week, and my own commitments repeat weekly, so the week after looks the same for me.

Mara — Mon 10:00 is out for me (lab block). My preference: **Wed 13:00-13:30**, next week if Alvarez and John are free then, otherwise the same slot the week after. — Sarah

Agreed, John — no slot covers all four of us next week. If we move to the week after, my commitments repeat, so **Wed 13:00-13:30** stays my best slot (Tue 15:00-15:30 also works, Mon 10:00 doesn't).

So: 30 minutes, week after, Wed 13:00-13:30 — Mara, John, Prof. Alvarez, does that hold for you? If yes I'll log it and we're done; if the week after slips for anyone, say so and I'll re-check the alternatives. — Sarah

Prof. — our messages crossed: Mara says Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00 and Wed 13:00 are all awkward for her next week, so none of those three works for all four of us. She suggested the following week instead.

Thanks Mara, that settles it. I wanted this meeting for next week, but the three slots that work for John and Sarah don't work for you, and the rest of my next week is lecturing, office hours and committee work — so there's no slot next week that fits all four of us.

So let's take the following week. For me Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00 and Wed 13:00 all work. Keep it to 30 minutes as planned — that's enough for the material and the grading calibration; if we need longer once we're in it, we'll extend then. Sarah, John — any of those three collide with your commitments? If not, Mara picks. — Prof. Alvarez

Sorry Prof. Alvarez, I think we crossed — my reply is just above.

One thing worth settling first: do we want 30 minutes, or should we block 45–60 for the material plus grading calibration? That decides which slots are actually viable. — Mara

Sarah ruled out Mon 10:00, so the two that clear all four of us are Tue 15:00-15:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 — and 30 minutes is fine for me, so either works. My own preference is Wed 13:00-13:30.

Agreed on all points. Decision: 30 minutes, 13:00-13:30, and we drop next week — no slot there fits the four of us. So: **Wednesday 13:00-13:30, the week after next**.

Sarah: that's your best slot, and you said it repeats weekly. John: you had Wed 13:00 as workable and you'll confirm when that week is fixed. Mara: you listed Wed 13:00 as working for you that week — please confirm it's good, and I'll log it and we're done. Thanks Prof. — and thanks Sarah for laying out the windows so clearly.

Week after it is, and I'll take **Wed 13:00-13:30** (Wed 2 Dec). It's Sarah's preferred slot, it's in the free windows for John and you, and it's clear for me. Keeping it at 30 minutes as you said, so we finish right as Sarah's quiz section starts.
